causes.label: demand
causes.quote: Very high temperatures in Melbourne and Adelaide led to high demand in both regions.

causes.label: wind_output
causes.quote: The difference was primarily due to reduced availability of wind generation. During the high priced trading intervals semi-scheduled wind generation reached a maximum of 390 MW, as compared to an installed capacity of 2400 MW. Wind generation in both regions was 160 to 220 MW below forecast, reducing potential supply of low-priced electricity.

causes.label: interconnector_limit
causes.quote: Despite higher than forecast imports from neighbouring regions (New South Wales and Tasmania), higher-priced local generation was needed to meet demand.
